hni_signals: PROCTOR FOR COMPLEX CORONARY INTERVENTIONS - publicly stated on his profile. Proctoring means he is credentialled by a device manufacturer or society to train and supervise OTHER interventional cardiologists in complex coronary technique, which places him above ordinary consultant level in his own peer group and is one of the strongest publicly-stated standing signals available for an interventionalist. Billed by Yashoda itself as Senior Consultant Interventional Cardiologist and used as the named face of its public cardiology content (a Health Talk session and a hospital video). Very high stated procedural volume: over 30,000 coronary angiograms and 10,000 angioplasties. Sub-specialises in the hardest end of the field - complex PCI and chronic total occlusions (CTO), plus structural heart work (TAVR, TMVR, MitraClip) and aortic stent grafts. International credentials: Fellow of the American College of Cardiology (FACC) and Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions (SCAI), Washington, USA. Academic and society standing: Associate Editor of the Indian Heart Journal, Executive Committee member of the Cardiological Society of India, member of the European Heart Failure Association, the European Association of Percutaneous Cardiovascular Interventions and the Indian College of Cardiology. Trained DM Cardiology at NIMS Hyderabad, MD General Medicine at Kasturba Medical College, MBBS at Mahadevappa Rampure Medical College. Runs his own personal consultant-brand website. Sits on the advisory board of a medical-travel company (Easy Treatment India), i.e. is marketed to international self-paying patients. Registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. Editorial, society-office and fellowship claims come from profile text and are not independently confirmed.
